about_the_game:
The perfect 1v1 mini games galore for casual scrubs like us. You and your sibling are tasked to complete certain chores before your mom returns home. Let them know you are THE superior sibling. Be the one to complete more assignments so you can get all the love from mommy. You can choose to do either of these things at a given time:

COMPLETE CHORES

If you get to finish the three tasks that your mother assigned you to do when the time runs out, you will given a star that you can use to run the wheel to get forbidden item. These are simple tasks such as cleaning the toilet, putting fruits on the fridge, and many more. Failure to do any task by the end of the day will automatically eliminate you from the family. Jk. You just lose that round and an immediate guarantee that you won't get a star, that's all.

WHACK A SIBLING

If you meet your sibling when you are about to do your daily task, you can smack them with items that you can find around the house. Remember, if you get hit, you will be temporarily stunned for a few seconds, which makes them have the upper hand in completing their tasks. I say we strike FIRST, always.

SABOTAGE

The art of getting praised is to make it look like you are the only one doing them. You can pay your dearest sibling a visit and let them know who's the alpha by ruining their tasks within the 5 seconds window that you have, so they outta spend more time doing that task.

UNLOCK FORBIDDEN ITEMS

The more you win, the more forbidden items you will get to unlock. These will make your sibling REGRET ever trying to contest your superiority.  

WHAT'S IN THIS GAME?

  • 2 characters 

  • 12 mini games

  • 8 forbidden items to unlock

  • 14 achievements

That's all you gotta do to win mommy's heart. Do you have what it takes to be the favorite child?
